Casey (Eng Manager): New senior infra hire starts Mon. Need a super-compact manager checklist I can paste into calendar invites: prestart steps, a focused week1 plan, and a short 30/60/90 with measurable outcomes. Who to ping for access/equipment?
Ruth (People Ops): @Casey 10-word copy/paste manager checklist: Prestart: confirm address + OS, create SSO, assign buddy, open IT access ticket. Day1: team intro (20m), 1:1 (45m), dev-env pairing (45m). Day2: env finish + security training. Day3: runbooks + small safe task. Day4: cross-team intros. Day5: demo + feedback. 30/60/90 (one-liners): 30d: env+access done, 2 PRs shipped, trainings complete. 60d: own small component, propose latency/cost improvement. 90d: ship measurable improvement and own rollout. Manager tips: block deep work, set daily 15m async check-ins week1, give a clear first small win.
Noah (IT): For access/equipment ping IT with this ticket body: Title: Onboarding access for <name>. Needs: GitHub org redwood-inference (team), Jira group inference-eng, GCP dev access, SSH key provisioning, laptop (mac/linux) + dongle. Include new hire email and start date to expedite.
Lee (HR): I will send benefits + payroll links and schedule a benefits intro if desired. Reminder: complete I-9 & tax forms within 7 days.
Pri (Buddy): Happy to be buddy. Ill seed a tiny starter issue and run the dev-env pairing Tue afternoon.
onboard-bot: Created folder https://redwood.internal/onboarding/compact-manager and attached a 30/60/90 template.
Casey (Eng Manager): Perfect 1thanks everyone. Ill post the welcome blurb and share calendar invites.
